title: Headless Dead Money fail branch (DeadMoney.esm): part 1 to Dog found at the police station, Dog killed (Find Collar 8, NVDLC01MQ01a 255); docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: The first part is the Dead Money chain's own (dead-money.actions.json), part 1; this branch kills Dog at the police station while Find Collar 8 runs (fight stand-in: kill, the player as killer): Dog's OnDeath fails the quest (NVDLC01MQ01a 255). It ends there.

Starts after the base game's opening: VCG01 done, and the reference that the trigger outside Doc Mitchell's house enables is enabled (the add-on's start quest waits for it). Message boxes hold the game (given menu 1001 closed); each box is closed as the player's OK would.
NVDLC01MQ00 (start game enabled) waits 30 s after that reference is enabled, then sets stage 10: the broadcast message, the bunker's door unlocked and its map marker shown.

Travel to the abandoned bunker (stand-in) and walk to the radio at its far end: the player stands in its trigger (OnTrigger, physics sensors stand in). It sets MQ00 100, gasses the player, takes the gear into a container and after the timers starts NVDLC01Intro, which moves the player into the slide room.

actions.label: milestone: NVDLC01MQ00 100 (Sierra Madre Grand Opening! done)

actions.text: The player lands in the slide room's trigger (physics sensors stand in): the narrator's SayTo chain says every opening slide; the last one's SayToDone starts the Villa transition timer, which moves the player to the Villa's start marker.

actions.label: opening slides said, Villa transition started

actions.text: The start marker is by the Villa fountain; the player stands in the fountain's trigger. It starts NVDLC01FountainStartSequence, whose timer starts NVDLC01MQ01 at stage 5 (the collar, the jumpsuit and the holorifle) and activates Elijah's hologram.

The sequence activates Elijah's hologram (a talking activator) on the player's behalf. Its conversation opens through it (a script's activation by the player opens the talk, as the play loop does). The player asks the first questions and takes the goodbye that starts the three collar quests.
Find Collar 8: Dog (NVDLC01MQ01a). Travel to the police station (stand-in); the player stands in the trigger by Dog's cell (stage 20).

The police station's ham radios jam the collar (two of them are in range where travel puts the player; the collar starts beeping). The player switches all four off by hand (their OnActivate), as a player would before the long talk; travel by MoveTo would otherwise leave the player counted inside their radius (the radios' distance check runs only while their cell is loaded) and the collar would go off later.

actions.label: collar quiet at the police station
